## This work (Р-216)

One scenario of the collection «Двери во тьму» (official Russian edition, `dveri-vo-tmu-ru`, printed page = physical + 1 — the offset is in the registry). **The Russian PDF has no text layer** (a scan): read its pages by OCR — `pdftoppm -r 200 -f N -l N -png <pdf> <out>` then `tesseract <png> - -l rus` — and check every number on the page image. The English original `doors-to-darkness-en` (text layer; printed = physical − 1; Genius Loci p. 35, Servants of the Lake p. 56, Ties That Bind p. 76, None More Black p. 96, collected handouts pp. 111–125, pre-generated characters pp. 126+) — to find pages, check numbers and fill `name.en`. «Тьма под холмом» is already in the base: model and conventions of this work — `kb/books/dveri-vo-tmu-ru/scenarios/darkness-beneath-the-hill.json` and its report `checks/20261112-doors-darkness-hill/darkness.md`. The fan file `[RU-фан 7e] Развеять мрак.pdf` in the folder is not the official edition — not a source. Run tools as `python -B …`.

- Russian text: as printed in the official edition (no `translated` for text taken from it; names and terms as in the Russian book). Handouts — the book's collected handouts or the official Russian handouts in `…\Двери во тьму (Doors to Darkness)\Раздатка\` (scans; OCR).
- Records — book-scoped `dveri-vo-tmu-ru/<kind>/<slug>` in `kb/books/dveri-vo-tmu-ru/<kinds>/`, slugs with your scenario's prefix (`genius-`, `lake-`, `ties-`, `black-`); the scenario record — English slug (`genius-loci`, `servants-of-the-lake`, `ties-that-bind`, `none-more-black`): summary, keeper_info, hook, advice, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards, tables; every scene retold for play (`arc`), items, handouts, organizations, characters (statblocks as printed, Р-25; the book's pre-generated investigators already exist in `kb/books/dveri-vo-tmu-ru/characters/` — link them, do not duplicate), creatures (known Mythos creatures → `instance_of` the shared `coc:creature:*`), places. The city — a shared city record `coc:location:<slug>` (Providence and Arkham exist; create a missing one, Р-190), the scenario's places as book records `part_of` it, places outside it under «Окрестности <города>» (Р-209). Maps — `map` records with the image (`app/maps/dveri-<prefix>-<slug>.jpg`, `width`/`height`) and spots on every printed number/label (Р-206: check each by eye on a crop); every key number gets a place record. List captions (`keeper_hint`) — neutral, no spoilers (Р-209).
- `axes.era` as the scenario says (1920s by default; modern if set today), `ruleset` "core". Book misprints — `errata` as printed (Р-35); RU vs EN differences in numbers — `quality.notes`.
- Coverage: `checks/20261112-doors-collection/<unit>.md` — every heading of the scenario → record(s), «не взято» with the reason.
